purpose: Curated plant-health evidence registry for dr-plant. Records are references and research leads, not diagnostic training labels unless explicitly validated.

rules.promotion: A finding may be used as diagnostic evidence only after expert review, symptom verification, image provenance and license checks.
rules.socialMedia: Social-media posts are leads only. Never treat captions or comments as confirmed diagnoses.
rules.images: Do not copy or redistribute images until their license or explicit permission is verified.
rules.uncertainty: Keep suspected, reported, and confirmed findings separate.

diseases.notes: Reference for symptom research; local field confirmation is still required.

datasets.name: GVLiD
datasets.intendedUse: Candidate for future model development after downloading, auditing labels, checking image-level license and creating a held-out evaluation split.
datasets.notes: Field-acquired images; metadata and expert-verified annotations are described in the 2026 data descriptor. Origin is Maharashtra, India, so regional transfer to Syrian coastal vineyards must be tested.

datasets.name: HERMOS grape disease dataset
datasets.intendedUse: Candidate for research; inspect annotation format, provenance and class balance before training.
datasets.notes: 914 images and 13,904 Pascal VOC annotations; source region is western Turkey. Verify actual downloadable package and annotation integrity before training.

datasets.name: FieldVitis
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for the cited upstream sources; verify attribution and terms for each included image/source before redistribution.
datasets.intendedUse: Candidate field-image collection; audit upstream provenance and duplicate overlap before use.
datasets.notes: Field images with class counts; dataset is imbalanced and combines upstream datasets, so deduplication against source datasets is required.
